reads: window.MCC_SITE (the generated block at the top of js/shell-boot.js)
rule: Each entry is a file that still names a site host in code, outside the generated outputs of tools/build-site-hosts.mjs: its count of host literals (comments are not counted) and the stage that converts it. The list only shrinks (scripts/test/site-hosts.test.mjs): a file on no list may not name a host, a listed file may not name more hosts than its count, and a file that names none leaves its list.
how_to_leave: Convert the file to read its hosts from window.MCC_SITE (the generated block at the top of js/shell-boot.js), run node tools/build-site-hosts.mjs --scan, and lower the count to what the scan prints; at zero delete the entry. Never raise a count. Edit only your own lane's list.
owned_note: Owned by the music engine build (SPEC-ENGINE): the platform lanes never edit them, and their host literals stay until the engine converts them. Host logic in these files is rebuilt by SPEC-ENGINE stage 2 (the World on the engine), which lands after P1 so it is built once, for one origin (SPEC-PLATFORM 5).
